meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 这个技能帮你把聊天渠道（如 Telegram、Slack）接到指定的智能体小组，管理隔离级别（共享会话、共享智能体或独立智能体），并新增渠道组；它会检查当前配置，逐步执行注册或改接，再显示可读的配置汇总。
howto.when: 在刚添加渠道之后、初始设置期间，或想单独重新配置渠道与智能体组的对应时启用。若实例还没有所有者，会先让你运行 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 把这个 Telegram 群接给现有智能体组，共享会话。
添加一个独立的新渠道组，给 Slack 新群单独建 agent。
say.note: 选择分离隔离，创建新文件夹。

say.text: 把这个渠道从 A 组改接到 B 组。
say.note: 旧会话保留在 A 组，新消息去 B 组。

howto.what_en: This skill wires messaging channels to agent groups, manages isolation levels (shared session, shared agent, or separate agent), and adds new channel groups. It inspects current state, walks through registering or rewiring, then shows a readable configuration summary.
howto.when_en: Use after adding a channel, during initial setup, or standalone to reconfigure channel-to-agent wiring. If no owner exists yet, it tells the user to run /init-first-agent first.

say_en.text: Wire this Telegram group to the existing agent group, shared session.
Add a separate channel group: a new agent for a new Slack group.
say_en.note: Chooses full isolation with a new folder.

say_en.text: Move this channel from agent group A to agent group B.
say_en.note: Old sessions stay with A; new messages go to B.
